India opposes UN 'unverified allegations' on protests

India has opposed the use of "unverified allegations" to negatively portray the country at the UN General Assembly's Third Committee. Deputy Secretary Barkha Tamrakar stated that India opposes turning such allegations into a negative characterization, particularly amid concerns raised by UN experts regarding Delhi's youth-led protests. The statement was made in response to these concerns.
